ICCameraDevice.doc: An object that represents a camera.

ICCameraFile.doc: An object that represents a file on a camera.

ICCameraFolder.doc: An object that represents a folder on a camera.

ICCameraItem.doc: An abstract class that represents a camera item.

ICDevice.doc: An abstract object that represents a device.

ICDeviceBrowser.doc: An object for finding digital cameras and scanners.

ICScannerBandData.doc: The options for each band of data that the scanner reads.

ICScannerDevice.doc: An object that represents a scanner.

ICScannerFeature.doc: An abstract class that describes a scanner feature.

ICScannerFeatureBoolean.doc: A feature with a value of YES or NO.

ICScannerFeatureEnumeration.doc: A feature that can have one of several discrete values, strings or numbers.

ICScannerFeatureRange.doc: A feature with a value that lies within a range.

ICScannerFeatureTemplate.doc: A group of one or more rectangular scan areas that can be used with a scanner functional unit.

ICScannerFunctionalUnit.doc: An abstract class that represents a scanner functional unit.

ICScannerFunctionalUnitDocumentFeeder.doc: An object that represents the document feeder unit on a scanner.

ICScannerFunctionalUnitFlatbed.doc: An object that represents the flatbed unit on a scanner.

ICScannerFunctionalUnitNegativeTranspare.doc: An object that represents the transparency unit for scanning negatives on the scanner.

ICScannerFunctionalUnitPositiveTranspare.doc: An object that represents the transparency unit for scanning positives on the scanner.

ICCameraDeviceDelegate.doc: Methods for detecting cameras, getting metadata and thumbnails, handling access and capability changes, and performing other actions on connected cameras.

ICCameraDeviceDownloadDelegate.doc: Methods for managing camera file downloads.

ICDeviceBrowserDelegate.doc: Methods for managing the addition and removal of devices and responding to device changes.

ICDeviceDelegate.doc: Methods for responding to device events and changes.

ICScannerDeviceDelegate.doc: Methods for determining availability, selecting a functional unit, and performing scans on connected scanners.

ICDeviceLocationType.doc: The location of the image capture device.

ICDeviceLocationTypeLocal.doc: A device that’s directly attached to the Mac through its USB or FireWire port.

ICDeviceLocationTypeShared.doc: A device that’s shared by other Mac hosts.

ICDeviceLocationTypeMask.doc: Masks for detecting different device locations.

ICDeviceLocationTypeMaskBluetooth.doc: A mask for detecting a paired Bluetooth device.

ICDeviceLocationTypeMaskBonjour.doc: A mask for detecting a network device that publishes a Bonjour service.

ICDeviceLocationTypeMaskLocal.doc: A mask for detecting a local device, such as USB or FireWire.

ICDeviceLocationTypeMaskRemote.doc: A mask for detecting a remote device, such as a shared, Bonjour, or Bluetooth device.

ICDeviceLocationTypeMaskShared.doc: A mask for detecting a device shared by another Mac host.

ICDeviceType.doc: The type of image capture device.

ICDeviceTypeMask.doc: Masks for detecting different device types.

ICDeviceTypeMaskCamera.doc: A mask for detecting a camera.

ICDeviceTypeMaskScanner.doc: A mask for detecting a scanner.

ICScannerBitDepth.doc: The number of bits per channel in the scanned image.

ICScannerColorDataFormatType.doc: The color data formats relevant to multichannel data.

ICScannerFeatureTypeBoolean.doc: A feature with a value of YES or NO.

ICScannerFeatureTypeEnumeration.doc: A feature that can have one of several discrete values, strings, or numbers.

ICScannerFeatureTypeRange.doc: A feature with a value that lies within a range.

ICScannerFeatureTypeTemplate.doc: A group of one or more rectangular scan areas that can be used with a scanner functional unit.

ICScannerFunctionalUnitState.doc: Flags to indicate the state of the scanner functional unit.

ICScannerFunctionalUnitStateOverviewScan.doc: A flag indicating that the functional unit is performing an overview scan.

ICScannerFunctionalUnitStateReady.doc: A flag indicating that the functional unit is ready for operation.

ICScannerFunctionalUnitStateScanInProgre.doc: A flag indicating that the functional unit is performing a scan.

ICScannerFunctionalUnitType.doc: The types of scanner functional units.

ICScannerFunctionalUnitTypeNegativeTrans.doc: A transparency functional unit for scanning negatives.

ICScannerFunctionalUnitTypePositiveTrans.doc: A transparency functional unit for scanning positives.

ICScannerMeasurementUnit.doc: The unit of measurement used by the scanner.

ICScannerTransferMode.doc: The modes for transferring scan data from the scanner functional unit.

ICScannerTransferModeFileBased.doc: The mode for transferring the scan as a file.

ICScannerTransferModeMemoryBased.doc: The mode for transferring the scan as data.

-cancelDownload.doc: Cancels a download from the camera.

-filesOfType:.doc: Returns an array of files of the selected type on the camera.

-requestDeleteFiles:deleteFailed:complet.doc: Deletes files from the camera, with the ability to catch failures and execute a completion block.

-requestDisableTethering.doc: Disables tethered capture on the camera.

-requestDownloadFile:options:downloadDel.doc: Downloads a file from the camera.

-requestEnableTethering.doc: Enables tethered capture if the camera has the capability to take pictures while connected.

-requestReadDataFromFile:atOffset:length.doc: Asynchronously reads data of a specified length from a specified offset.

-requestSendPTPCommand:outData:completio.doc: Sends a Picture Transfer Protocol (PTP) command to a camera asynchronously.

-requestSendPTPCommand:outData:sendComma.doc: Sends a Picture Transfer Protocol (PTP) command to a camera asynchronously.

-requestSyncClock.doc: Synchronizes the camera’s clock with the computer’s clock.

-requestTakePicture.doc: Captures a new image using the camera.

-requestUploadFile:options:uploadDelegat.doc: Uploads a file to the camera.

-requestDownloadWithOptions:completion:.doc: Requests a download and executes the completion block in place of the delegate.

-requestMetadataDictionaryWithOptions:co.doc: Requests metadata and executes the completion block in place of the delegate.

-requestReadDataAtOffset:length:completi.doc: Requests to asynchronously read data of a specified length from a specified offset, then executes the completion block.

-requestThumbnailDataWithOptions:complet.doc: Requests a thumbnail and executes the completion block in place of the delegate.

-requestThumbnail.doc: Requests a thumbnail for the item.

-requestCloseSession.doc: Requests to close an open session on the device.

-requestCloseSessionWithOptions:completi.doc: Requests to close an open session on the device, then executes the completion handler.

-requestEject.doc: Requests to eject the media if permitted by the device, or to disconnect from a remote device.

-requestEjectOrDisconnect.doc: Requests to eject the media if permitted by the device, or to disconnect from a remote device.

-requestEjectWithCompletion:.doc: Requests to eject the media if permitted by the device, or to disconnect from a remote device, then executes the completion handler.

-requestOpenSession.doc: Requests to open a session on the device.

-requestOpenSessionWithOptions:completio.doc: Requests to open a session on the device, then executes the completion handler.

-requestSendMessage:outData:maxReturnedD.doc: Asynchronously sends an arbitrary message with optional data to a device.

-requestYield.doc: Requests that device module in control of this device yield control.

-start.doc: Tells the delegate to start looking for devices.

-stop.doc: Tells the delegate to stop looking for devices.

-requestOpenSessionWithCredentials:passw.doc: Opens a session on the protected device with the authorized username and passcode.

-requestOverviewScan.doc: Starts an overview scan on the selected functional unit.

-requestScan.doc: Starts a scan on the selected functional unit.

-requestSelectFunctionalUnit:.doc: Requests to select a functional unit on the scanner.

accessRestrictedAppleDevice.doc: A Boolean value indicating whether the device is an Apple device, passcode-locked, and connected to an untrusted host.

batteryLevelAvailable.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the battery charge level is available.

contentCatalogPercentCompleted.doc: The percentage of the camera’s content that has been catalogued.

contents.doc: All image, movie, and audio files stored on the camera, in an order that reflects the camera’s storage folder structure.

ejectable.doc: A Boolean value indicating whether the device can be ‘soft’ removed or disconnected.

iCloudPhotosEnabled.doc: A Boolean value indicating whether the iCloud Photo Library is enabled on the device.

locked.doc: A Boolean value indicating whether the device is locked, preventing deletion of any asset.

mediaFiles.doc: All image, movie and audio files stored on the camera, without regard to the camera’s storage folder structure.

mountPoint.doc: The file system mount point for a camera using the mass storage transport type.

ptpEventHandler.doc: A closure for handling PTP event packets.

tetheredCaptureEnabled.doc: A Boolean value indicating whether tethered capture is enabled on the camera.

timeOffset.doc: The time offset, in seconds, between the camera’s clock and the computer’s clock.

burstFavorite.doc: A Boolean value that indicates this file is the burst favorite in a burst.

burstPicked.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether this file is user picked in a burst.

burstUUID.doc: The burst UUID of the file if it is in a burst.

createdFilename.doc: The created name of the file.

duration.doc: The duration, in seconds, of an audio or video file.

exifCreationDate.doc: The EXIF creation date of the file.

exifModificationDate.doc: The EXIF modification date of the file.

fileCreationDate.doc: The creation date of the file.

fileModificationDate.doc: The modification date of the file.

fileSize.doc: The size of the file, in bytes.

firstPicked.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether a file is autopicked by Photos to represent the burst.

gpsString.doc: The GPS String of the file in standard format.

groupUUID.doc: The group UUID of the file.

height.doc: The height of an image or movie frame.

highFramerate.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the file is a slow motion or high-frame-rate video file.

orientation.doc: The orientation to use when downloading the image.

originalFilename.doc: The original name of the file on disk.

originatingAssetID.doc: The originating asset ID of an HEIF or HVEC file.

pairedRawImage.doc: A sidecar file containing the logical RAW compliment of a JPG or other two-format image.

relatedUUID.doc: A related UUID correlating several images from an Apple device.

sidecarFiles.doc: An array of two camera files associated with this file.

timeLapse.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the file is a time-lapse video file.

width.doc: The width of an image or movie frame.

contents.doc: A list of items that this folder contains.

UTI.doc: The item’s uniform type identifier (UTI) string.

addedAfterContentCatalogCompleted.doc: A Boolean value indicating whether the item was captured on the camera after the camera’s content had been fully enumerated.

creationDate.doc: The item’s creation date, usually the same as its EXIF creation date.

fileSystemPath.doc: The item’s file system path on a camera using the mass storage transport type.

inTemporaryStore.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether this item is in a temporary store.

largeThumbnailIfAvailable.doc: A large thumbnail for the item if one is readily available.

locked.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the storage card in the camera is locked.

metadataIfAvailable.doc: The item’s metadata if it is readily available.

modificationDate.doc: The item’s modification date, usually the same as its EXIF modification date.

ptpObjectHandle.doc: The item’s PTP object handle value, if the camera uses the PTP protocol.

raw.doc: A Boolean value indicating whether the item is a raw image file.

thumbnailIfAvailable.doc: The item’s thumbnail if it is readily available.

userData.doc: A mutable dictionary to store arbitrary key-value pairs associated with a camera item.

UUIDString.doc: A string representation of the device’s universally unique identifier (UUID).

autolaunchApplicationPath.doc: The file system path of an application to launch automatically when this device is added.

capabilities.doc: The capabilities of the device as reported by the device module.

delegate.doc: The delegate to receive messages once a session is opened on the device.

hasOpenSession.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the device has an open session.

locationDescription.doc: A nonlocalized location description for the device.

moduleExecutableArchitecture.doc: The executable architecture of the device module servicing the requests.

modulePath.doc: The file system path of the device module associated with this device.

moduleVersion.doc: The bundle version of the device module associated with this device.

name.doc: The device’s name as reported by the device module, or if no device module is in control of this device, by the device transport.

persistentIDString.doc: A string representation of the device’s persistent ID.

remote.doc: A Boolean value indicating whether the device is published by the Image Capture device-sharing facility.

transportType.doc: The hardware connection type the device is using.

type.doc: A combination of the device’s type and its location type.

usbLocationID.doc: The USB location that the device is occupying.

usbProductID.doc: The USB Product ID (PID) associated with the device.

usbVendorID.doc: The USB Vendor ID (VID) associated with the device.

userData.doc: A bookkeeping object for client convenience.

browsedDeviceTypeMask.doc: A mask whose set bits indicate the type of devices being browsed after the delegate receives the start message.

browsing.doc: A Boolean value indicating whether the device browser is browsing for devices.

delegate.doc: The object that acts as the delegate of the device browser.

devices.doc: All devices found by the browser.

preferredDevice.doc: Returns a device object that the client application should select when it launches.

availableFunctionalUnitTypes.doc: An array of functional unit types available on this scanner.

defaultUsername.doc: A default username on protected scanners.

maxMemoryBandSize.doc: The total maximum band size requested when performing a memory-based transfer.

selectedFunctionalUnit.doc: The currently selected functional unit on the scanner.

transferMode.doc: The transfer mode for the scanned document.
